ownerDecision.request: add these new tanks using our rigoorous tank generation workflow; the christian 2 is based off the leopard, take innnspo from japanese type 90. but dress it in a ton of netting and ghillie; that type90 is a leopard anyways so basee off of that type 90 pleasee
ownerDecision.scope: A new Christian II: an explicit first-party derivative of the Type 90 X build (type90X.ts kept byte-identical), with bolted side armour modules, bustle bins, Danish markings and paint and a heavy field net. Nation ruled by the coordinator the same day: a fictional Danish Army concept drawn as a Nordic special in the Sweden tree. The supplied concept model is a proportions reference only; nothing of it ships.

concept.operator: Danish Army (fictional concept; no real-world service history is claimed)
concept.rationale: A three-crew tank on the Type 90 X's hull, running gear and slab-sided turret with its bustle autoloader and Rh 120 L/44, uprated with bolted spaced modules along the compartment walls, stowage bins on the bustle flanks and a permanent heavy field net worked with beech garnish for a woodland theatre; it fires a DM53-class APFSDS.

christian2.silhouette: The Type 90 X's 7.80 m hull, six-wheel running gear and long slab-sided turret with its bustle autoloader, gunner's sight box and commander's panoramic head, carrying three bolted spaced armour modules along each compartment wall, stowage bins on the bustle flanks and a permanent heavy field net with beech garnish over the turret, the decks and the skirts; roof to 2.46 m, whips to 4.66 m.
